title: Nondeterministic space and deterministic time
statement: Let $S:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be space-constructible: there are a positive integer $a$ and a deterministic Turing machine that computes the binary representation of $S(n)$ using at most $aS(n)$ space on inputs of length $n$, and $1+\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor\le S(n)$ for every $n$. Then every language decidable nondeterministically in space bounded by a constant multiple of $S$ is decidable deterministically in time bounded by $2^{c(S(n)+1)}$ for some constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$; equivalently, $\mathrm{NSPACE}(S)\subseteq\bigcup_{c\in\mathbb{N}}\mathrm{DTIME}\bigl(n\mapsto 2^{c(S(n)+1)}\bigr)$.
